full_judgment: 4. The learned Assistant Judge recorded evidence of 3 witnesses for the petitioner and 6 witnesses of the opposite party No. 1 and after hearing; he dismissed the miscellaneous case with the findings that the case land under presumption being homestead land preemption under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act is not maintainable. That the petitioner knowing fully well about the actual sale values of Taka 49,000 deposited only Taka 7,000 with compensation thereof which was inadequate and that he did not exercise option to purchase the case land at that time.
